content.short: Hegic is an on-chain peer-to-pool options trading protocol on Arbitrum.
content.description: Hegic is an Arbitrum-based options trading platform powered by specialized smart contracts and liquidity pools. It aims to bring transparency, trustlessness, and on-chain settlement to Ethereum-based asset trading for ETH and wBTC. Users can participate as writers of options contracts and earn rewards through a liquidity-pool model that pools capital to support decentralized option creation and settlement, operating with on-chain transparency and auditable mechanics that reduce reliance on any single counterparty.
